document.cue: Describe a person who helps other people.

text: I'd like to talk about my neighbour, Mrs Gulnara. She is about sixty years old, and she lives on the second floor in our building. I have known her since I was a small child because she often looked after me when my parents were at work.

She helps a lot of people in our area. For example, she cooks food every week for old people who live alone, and she takes it to their houses. When somebody is ill, she goes to the pharmacy and buys medicine for them. She also teaches children from poor families how to read and write. She does not have much money herself, but she always finds time for others. Once, when my grandmother was in hospital, she visited her every day and brought soup. She is also the one who organises small parties for the holidays, and everybody in the building comes to eat and talk together. Sometimes she even asks me to help her carry the food.

I admire her because she helps people without asking for anything. She never says that she is tired, and she is always smiling. Many people in big cities are too busy and do not know their neighbours, but she is different. She makes our building feel like one big family. I think she is a very good example for young people like me. In the future, I would like to be kind and helpful like her.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: I'd like to talk about my neighbour, Mrs Gulnara

tips.en: Specific actions are better than general words about kindness.
tips.kk: Нақты әрекеттер мейірімділік туралы жалпы сөздерден жақсы.
tips.ru: Конкретные действия лучше общих слов о доброте.
tips.example: she cooks food every week for old people who live alone

tips.en: The reason for admiration is stated directly and simply.
tips.kk: Таңдану себебі тікелей әрі қарапайым айтылған.
tips.ru: Причина восхищения названа прямо и просто.
tips.example: I admire her because she helps people without asking for anything

note.en: Introduction: who the person is and how you know them.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бұл адам кім және онымен қалай таныссыз.
note.ru: Вступление: кто этот человек и как вы с ним знакомы.

note.en: Body: specific examples of how the person helps others.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: адамның басқаларға қалай көмектесетіні туралы нақты мысалдар.
note.ru: Основная часть: конкретные примеры того, как человек помогает другим.

note.en: Conclusion: why you admire them and a wish to be like them.
note.kk: Қорытынды: неге таңданатыныңыз және соған ұқсағыңыз келетіні.
note.ru: Заключение: почему вы восхищаетесь, и желание быть похожим.

document.title: A person who helps others
bullets: and explain why you admire them.
document.followUp: Do you want to be like this person?
